app.title: Healthcare Navigator
app.tagline: Find care, lower costs, understand your documents, and get help with paperwork — all in one place.
home.choose: What do you need help with today?
home.chooseHint: Pick a starting point. You can change paths later.
home.searchPlaceholder: ZIP code or symptoms (e.g. 60607 or chest pain)
home.careHint: Tell us where you are and what kind of care you need. We will look for nearby clinics, hospitals, and low-cost options.
home.moreHint: These start on their own pages, so you only see the questions that match the task.
home.findCareHint: Clinics, hospitals, ER-aware options, and directions.
home.lowerCostsHint: Medication prices, discounts, and local assistance.
home.docsHint: Bills, letters, and medical paperwork in plain language.
home.applyHint: Charity care, Medicaid checks, scripts, and forms.
emergency.title: This may be a medical emergency
emergency.body: Call 911 immediately. We will continue to find care options for you below.
emergency.psychiatric: Call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline). You are not alone.
privacy.badge: 🔒 We don't store your data. No account needed.
privacy.wiped: Your data has been wiped from this device.
privacy.b1: We never ask for your name, email, or immigration status.
privacy.b2: Form data stays on your phone. It is wiped when you close the tab.
privacy.b3: We don't track you. No analytics. No cookies.
docs.uploadHint: PDF, JPG, or PNG. We process in memory and never save.
docs.uploadLimit: PDF, JPG, or PNG · up to 10MB
docs.processing: Reading your document — this can take 10-20 seconds…
docs.charityHelp: Get help applying for charity care →
docs.multiHint: You can upload several at once — e.g. visit summary + bill.
docs.combinedNextSteps: What to do across all of these
docs.reconciling: Looking at all your documents together…
docs.ocrLowBody: The photo may be blurry, dark, or cropped. Try retaking with brighter light, or upload a PDF for a better result.
docs.chip.billCharity: Do I qualify for charity care?
docs.chip.labMeaning: What does this abnormal value mean?
docs.chip.visitQuestions: What should I ask my doctor next time?
docs.chip.visitWatch: What symptoms should I watch for?
costs.searchHint: Type a brand or generic name (e.g. Lipitor, atorvastatin)
apply.title: Get Help Applying
apply.name: Your name (optional)
apply.eligibilityFull: You likely qualify for full charity care.
apply.eligibilityPartial: You may qualify for a partial discount.
apply.eligibilityAbove: Your income appears above the published threshold.
apply.phoneScript: What to say on the phone
apply.medicaidEmergency: You may also qualify for Emergency Medicaid
apply.fundraiser.title: Start a medical fundraiser
apply.fundraiser.body: MIRA can draft a GoFundMe campaign for remaining bills, transportation, medicine, or recovery costs. You review everything before posting.
apply.fundraiser.notePlaceholder: e.g. missed work, child care, transportation
apply.fundraiser.fullContext: I am also applying for charity care, which may reduce the hospital bill. Donations will help with any remaining medical costs and basic recovery needs.
apply.fundraiser.partialContext: I may qualify for a partial hospital discount, but I still expect remaining costs. Donations will help cover the gap.
apply.fundraiser.generalContext: I am applying for financial assistance and trying to understand what support is available. Donations will help cover costs that assistance does not cover.
apply.fundraiser.update: We have started the financial-assistance process with {hospital}. The next step is calling {phone}, submitting required documents, and asking about charity care or payment-plan options. Thank you for helping us keep moving.
apply.fundraiser.disclaimer: This does not automatically create a GoFundMe. It prepares paste-ready text so the patient can review, edit, and publish it themselves.
disclaimer: This is information, not medical advice. Consult a healthcare professional for your specific situation.
care.noZip: No ZIP code is set. Please return to the home page.
care.reasonFqhc: Federally Qualified Health Centers must serve patients regardless of ability to pay or immigration status.
care.reasonSlidingScale: Offers sliding-scale fees based on income.
docs.getCharityHelp: Get help applying for charity care
costs.api.nadac: National average pharmacy reference price from CMS.
costs.api.goodrx: Coupon prices that may vary by pharmacy near you.
apply.medicaidEmergencyBody: Illinois Emergency Medicaid covers labor and delivery, ER visits, and dialysis regardless of immigration status.
apply.medicaidThreshold: {{percent}}% of FPL; threshold is 138% or less
apply.medicaidDoc1: Proof of Illinois residence, such as a utility bill, lease, or letter.
apply.medicaidDoc2: Photo ID or passport from any country.
apply.medicaidDoc3: Proof of income, such as recent pay stubs or an employer letter.
apply.medicaidDoc4: Proof of the medical emergency, such as ER discharge papers, prenatal records, or a dialysis order.
